description: "Paul Gerrard, the Cabin Boy" by William Henry Giles Kingston is a historical adventure novel written in the late 19th century. The story follows the young protagonist, Paul Gerrard, as he embarks on a challenging journey at sea after his family loses their fortune due to a lawsuit.
